name: polymerge-monorepo
description: Vertex-level correspondence diff (and future merge) for 3D models: STL, OBJ, glTF/GLB.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @polymerge/core && npm run build -w @polymerge/cli && npm run build -w @polymerge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @polymerge/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: node apps/web/e2e/smoke.mjs && node scripts/e2e-view.mjs && node scripts/e2e-worker.mjs && node scripts/e2e-git.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
